resources.string: GKD companion service (do not enable manually)

Managed automatically by GKD. Do not enable manually.

Helps automation work in some apps and keeps GKD running in the background.

Accessibility capabilities are disabled; only the service remains running, with minimal overhead. Some apps may still detect accessibility as enabled.
GKD touch optimization (do not enable manually)
Managed automatically by GKD. Do not enable manually.\n\nReads screen content and matches rules. The privileged service performs clicks and swipes to reduce touch stutter.
Custom screen clicking based on advanced selectors and subscription rules.\n\nUse custom selectors and subscription rules to click controls anywhere on screen and create custom shortcuts.
